name: Apple
fiscalYearEnd: Last Saturday of September (FY2025 ended 2025-09-27; FY2026 ends in late September 2026)
description: Apple designs and sells iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods and other devices, built by contract manufacturers mostly in Asia, and sells them through its own stores and online (40% of FY2025 net sales) and through carriers, wholesalers and resellers (60%). The iPhone is over half of sales. Around it sits Services: App Store commissions, advertising, AppleCare, iCloud, Apple Pay and Music and TV subscriptions, plus licensing payments from Google for search placement. Services was 25% of nine-month FY2026 net sales. The 10-K warns that the US antitrust remedies against Google could affect the Google payments. Apple pays a small dividend and spends far more on buybacks than on dividends.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recalled from the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. The box hides that Services is a quarter of sales and the higher-margin profit engine (see description).

hq.note: One Apple Park Way, Cupertino, CA 95014 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: iPhone
businessLines.how: One-time hardware sale of each phone at a set price, largely through carriers and resellers; volume and mix toward higher-priced Pro models drive the line, and each phone also seeds the Services base.

businessLines.name: Services
businessLines.how: Recurring: a commission on App Store sales, subscriptions (iCloud, Music, TV, AppleCare), payments fees, advertising, and a licensing payment from Google LLC for search; all grow with the installed base of devices. Apple does not disclose profit by product line in what was read.

businessLines.name: Mac
businessLines.how: One-time hardware sale of laptops and desktops to consumers, schools and businesses.

revenue.note: +9% YoY; Q3 $10.4B (+29%, described as supply constrained)

businessLines.name: Wearables, Home and Accessories
businessLines.how: One-time sales of Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV, HomePod and accessories; usually bought by existing iPhone owners.
